Festive Season Shocker: Government Hikes Gold Hallmarking Fees to ₹75 Per Article as BIS Enforces New Rates
items.v2Summary: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) has increased gold hallmarking fees from ₹45 to ₹75 per article, a 67% rise, effective September 14, 2026. Silver jewelry fees are set at ₹35 per article. The new charges include a ₹7.50 administrative fee per gold piece and a ₹3.50 BIS levy, with a minimum consignment fee of ₹200 plus taxes. Retailers and consumers are concerned about the impact on lightweight jewelry purchases, with calls for a fee rollback and stricter enforcement against fake hallmarking.
